ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in a circle $\odot O$, where $\overset{\frown}{AD}=\overset{\frown}{CD}$, $\angle ABD=33^\circ$, and $\angle ACB=44^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle BAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \overset{\frown}{AD}=\overset{\frown}{CD}$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABD=\angle DBC=\angle DAC=33^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle ABC=\angle ABD+\angle DBC=33^\circ+33^\circ=66^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC=180^\circ-\angle ABC-\angle ACB=180^\circ-66^\circ-44^\circ=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
